items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: You could go from one to the other and hear Billie Holiday or whatever

ctx.x: 52nd Street must have been a marvelous place to be.

Well they had these places very close to each other. You could go from one to the other and hear Billie Holiday or whatever, and I remember — I’m trying to tell it the correct way because then it wasn’t illegal to smoke pot. And I remember people in the audience, like some of these stars and some of the publishers, would be sitting at the bar doing their thing, and this was before I even thought about it or knew about it. Of course I never inhaled. But they didn’t either. But it was amazing when I found out later…
Did it affect the players, the music, the way they played, do you think?
